scientific_question: Can one shared compact linear map turn a deployment-visible exact-adjoint lift of centered observations into the v179 affine coordinates across reported geometry and five/nine active cameras, while preserving the frozen K0 and unchanged-CGLS-K1 accuracy gates on an entirely excluded trajectory and resisting cheaper explanations?
role: post-open development diagnostic on the same four already-open p22-s01 frames; the complete p22 trajectory remains excluded from every fitted statistic, coefficient, rank choice, ridge choice, normalization, fallback, and stopping rule
physical_distinction: v180 does not cache or invert a 1009-column measurement matrix at deployment. It computes one exact adjoint lift from the current centered observation, normalizes by active-camera count, and applies one shared diagonal-plus-rank-16 map fitted only on complete PoolFire fit trajectories. This differs from the v179 per-geometry exact pseudoinverse and from previously closed fixed-coordinate CNN/FNO families.

data_isolation.fit_source: exactly the ten complete train-split trajectories and 1010 transformed fields inherited through v178 and v179
data_isolation.fit_geometry_arms: thirteen immutable calibrations crossed with the frozen v176 five-camera subset and all-nine control, yielding 26 geometry/sensor blocks
data_isolation.heldout_source: exactly p=22kw_size=01 with only the four already-open frame indices 0,25,75,100 inherited through v179
heldout_truth_allowed_only_for: synthetic observation generation through the frozen forward operator
final field and gradient scoring after every observation-only candidate is sealed

affine_representation.definition: rebuild the v178/v179 arithmetic fit mean and direct thin-SVD basis from the same 1010 fit fields
affine_representation.sign_canonicalization: largest-absolute field entry is nonnegative; ties use the lowest flat index

deployment_feature.name: normalized_affine_exact_adjoint
deployment_feature.centered_observation: r_y=y-A_c mean_fit, where A_c mean_fit is a geometry setup cache and not a heldout-truth statistic

fit_statistics.streaming_rule: for each fit-only geometry block form M=A_c U^T and H=M^T M, then accumulate g=aH/n_camera without storing the 26260 by 1009 design matrix
fit_statistics.feature_mean: arithmetic mean over all 26260 fit rows
fit_statistics.feature_scale: population standard deviation over all 26260 fit rows with an absolute floor of 1e-12
fit_statistics.target_mean: arithmetic mean of the repeated fit affine coordinates over all 26260 fit rows
fit_statistics.ridge_objective: mean squared residual plus 1e-3 times squared Frobenius norm
fit_statistics.solve_rule: solve (Z^T Z + N*0.001 I)B=Z^T Y by symmetric eigendecomposition with eigenvalues sorted ascending and no data-dependent cutoff

primary_model.name: shared_diagonal_plus_rank16_adjoint_map
primary_model.definition: fit one diagonal ridge map from standardized g to centered affine coordinates; fit a full ridge map to its residual; retain exactly the first 16 singular components of the residual map; prediction is target_mean + z*diagonal + z*rank16_residual_map
primary_model.fallback: none; any non-finite statistic, solve failure, rank failure, or evaluation failure makes the run inconclusive

shared_diagonal_adjoint_map.definition: the same standardized exact-adjoint feature and ridge objective, retaining only the 1009 per-coordinate diagonal gains and target mean

affine_coordinate_cgls1.definition: from mean_fit compute raw g=U A_c^T(y-A_c mean_fit), one exact projected forward M g, beta=(g^Tg)/((Mg)^T(Mg)), and a=beta*g with denominator floor 1e-30

fit_mean.definition: the immutable fit mean before and after one unchanged physical CGLS K1 step

evaluation.primary: shared_diagonal_plus_rank16_k0 and k1 on both frozen five-camera and all-nine arms
evaluation.subset_rule: reuse the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge five-camera subset index frozen before p22 truth was opened in v176
evaluation.physical_k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual; denominator floor 1e-30

frozen_operator.forward: same calibrated exact-adjoint straight-ray density-gradient proxy as v176-v179

exact_call_and_cache_ledger.truth_observation: one excluded offline forward per sensor arm, calibration, and frame
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.resource_claim: none before a later fresh-process wall/RSS gate

required_validity_gates: all v179 parent identities, statuses, decisions, arrays, and input trees remain unchanged
all fit, p22, calibration, subset, selection, and source trees remain unchanged
affine rank is exactly 1009 and basis orthogonality is within 1e-7
all 26260 fit rows are accounted for without p22 access
feature means, scales, Gram matrices, cross-products, diagonal gains, and rank-16 map are finite
the symmetric ridge solve stationarity is within 1e-8 and the residual map has exactly rank 16
model parameters and every observation-only candidate are sealed before p22 truth scoring
fixed-observation heldout-truth mutation leaves all features, coordinates, and fields byte-identical
camera permutation changes neither adjoint feature nor field candidate beyond 1e-10
all exact-call, mean-cache, fit-construction, and offline-scoring receipts equal the frozen ledger
formal and input trees remain unchanged
independent second implementation passes every required comparison

must_independently_rebuild: the ten fit input identities, 1010 fields, fit mean, 1009-direction affine basis, and fit affine coordinates
the thirteen calibrations, frozen five-camera selections, all-nine operators, and all 26 fit geometry blocks
streamed fit feature moments, standardized Gram and cross-product matrices, diagonal ridge, full residual ridge, and rank-16 truncation
all deployment exact-adjoint features, diagonal/rank-16/coordinate-CGLS/mean candidates before reading formal candidate arrays
physical K0/K1 replay, all 832 metric rows, exact-call/cache receipts, calibration and frame tails, control dominance, and decision

decision_order: Any identity, isolation, affine-basis, fit-row, normalization, ridge, rank, observation-only, mutation, geometry, adjoint, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v180 inconclusive.
If the rank-16 primary K0 or K1 fails both sensor arms, conclude FAIL_SHARED_COMPACT_ADJOINT_PRECONDITIONER_V180 and close this shared linear adjoint-preconditioner family.
If the rank-16 primary passes all-nine but fails the frozen five-camera arm, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_SHARED_COMPACT_ADJOINT_PRECONDITIONER_V180.
If the static mean K0 and K1 pass both sensor arms, conclude PASS_STATIC_MEAN_EXPLAINS_V180 and prefer the fixed prior.
If affine-coordinate CGLS1 K0 and K1 pass both sensor arms, conclude PASS_ONE_STEP_COORDINATE_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V180 and prefer the deterministic control.
If the shared diagonal K0 and K1 pass both sensor arms, conclude PASS_SHARED_DIAGONAL_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V180 and prefer the smaller fitted map; the rank-16 advantage is rejected.
Only if the rank-16 primary K0 and K1 pass both sensor arms while all three cheaper control families fail may v180 conclude PASS_COMPACT_SHARED_AFFINE_ADJOINT_HEADROOM_V180.

No v180 outcome is an external generalization result, exact-call reduction result, wall/RSS result, neural-operator advantage, curved-ray result, real BOST result, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
